## ❌ What This Data Product Cannot Access

- **ACV (Annual Contract Value)** - Not available in this data product
- **Cash flow** - Cash-based metrics not included
- **TCV (Total Contract Value)** - Contract totals not available
- **Profit** / **Operating margin** - No profit/margin data
- **Revenue targets** - Target/goal data not available in this data product
- **Revenue forecasts** - Forward-looking forecast data not included
- **Reasons behind revenue fall or revenue growth** - No causal analysis data
- **Customer-level revenue** - Customer dimension to be added
- **Discounting rates** - Not available in revenue data
- **External revenue** (Operational revenue excluding IBM contingencies) - Not yet available in this data product
  - IBM-related contingent revenue (intercompany transactions, Cloud Pak splits, revenue splits with IBM) is included in operational revenue
  - External revenue views are tracked separately in Division RT revenue views
  - Standard analysis includes all operational revenue (both external and IBM-related)
